notes.title: Bugfix Patch - 2022-07-26
notes.notes:
Hello doods,

We've published a small bugfix patch for the PC version of Makai Kingdom: Reclaimed and Rebound!

[h3]Fixes[/h3]

[list]
[*]Fixed crashes when trying to reincarnate or sort certain units in specific situations.
[*]Fixed error where cursor in game settings menu can go outside bounds.
[*]Fixed graphical error where roses were clipping through blood pool.
[*]Adjusted font size in specific menu during character creation.
[/list]

Have a good day!
